codeHelp: Compared as a string, case-insensitive; “01” and “1” match when both are numeric.
semanticHelp: Colour, icon and result panel — independent of the label.
label: Label (panel title)
showDetailsHelp: When the API returns the document type and issuer alongside the code.
needCode: The value returned by the API is required.
intro: The code as the API returns it, and what the page does with it.
badCode: Letters, digits, - . _ : / — no spaces, 24 characters at most.
duplicateCode: Another code in this catalogue already answers to that value.
needLabel: The French label is required — it is the fallback for every language.
needLabelEn: Fill in the English label (shown on /en/verification).
needLabelAr: Fill in the Arabic label (shown on /ar/verification).
descriptionHelp: Optional — shown under the label, inside the verdict frame.
